summary: ENvue Medical, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a 12-for-1 reverse stock split effective September 1, 2026, approved by the board under stockholder authority from a special meeting on August 14, 2026. A Delaware Certificate of Amendment was filed August 28, 2026. No fractional shares are issued; fractional entitlements round up. The stock continues trading on Nasdaq under symbol FEED with a new CUSIP. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation. Watch for continued Nasdaq listing compliance and potential liquidity effects, but no risk-arb or deal mechanics apply.
